text_block_list.text:
One day, Taiki Shuttle called me out to 
the central courtyard.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... You did well not to run away! 
Trainer—no, Bad Gang!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This is the end of your evil deeds! Are 
you get-ready to have a hole blasted in 
your stomach?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Of course it's because I've only been 
working lately and haven't been able to 
refresh myself at all, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Overtime, overtime late into the night! 
All work and no play is NO GOOD!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So play with me a whole lot today and give 
your body and soul a total refresh, YES!
choice_data_list:
...Come to think of it, I might have been 
working non-stop lately.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Right? Alright, I'm the wild west 
gunslinger, and you're the bad gang, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's a duel! I challenge you to a 
quick-draw battle!
choice_data_list: Got it, a battle it is!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, full of energy and so good~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready? The bell is about to ring. 
Turn around on that cue and... BANG!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My bullet strikes down evil, and peace 
makes a comeback to the West!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And so, here we go! Get set—
(Ding dong dang dooong...)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ――BANG！！！

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it was almost simultaneous!? The 
winner is...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes, victory!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... You weren't slow by any means 
either, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
BUUUT! It looks like you need more 
training to keep up with my quick draw, 
YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu, do you understand what happens 
when you get shot, *desu ka*?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If you get shot, it's a dead end and game 
over, you know! So please, take a break 
with NO overtime right now!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Eishin, just kidding! Please wake up 
once you're feeling better. I'll get 
lonely otherwise.

I was forced to take a day off. Thanks to 
Taiki Shuttle's consideration, I was able 
to rest up properly.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Mmm~! They're quite a tough bad gang!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But... you've made a big mistake! Because 
shooting me makes you guilty, deesu!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm the Sheriff! You shot someone, 
didn't you? For that crime—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Pig box! Off to the slammer you go! No 
more work for you today, no sir!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What I mean is, please rest. You are not 
at fault; fatigue is.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, it is pig-time to rest in the 
pigpen! If you smack it, it looks a whole 
lot like a pig, ya see!

I'm not really sure what you're talking 
about, but thanks to that, I got to have a 
nice, relaxing day off.
